name: @mistral/next-hotkey
//: React is the one host peer. Despite the package name, src/ never imports `next` — the upstream `next` peer was dropped when this package was vendored.
//scripts: The upstream scripts (pnpm -w …, mtsc, vitest) belong to the monorepo this package was vendored out of and cannot run here; they are dropped so nx does not pick this workspace member up as a build/test target.
//dependencies: Vendored out of the upstream monorepo: the upstream `catalog:`/`workspace:*` protocols are meaningless here, so every specifier is concrete. `usehooks-ts` is imported by src/use-hotkey.ts and was only a devDependency upstream — it is a real runtime dependency and is declared as one. `remeda` is imported by src/use-deep-equal-memo.ts and pinned to the version `@mistral/common` uses.
